description: Rebuild permission_scope enrichment module to fix weak signal plateau (currently 3 distinct values). MUST read MULTIPLE metadata fields (registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars, tool_count) to produce discriminative scores. Current version reads too few fields causing all MCPs to cluster at similar scores. Enforce enrichment contract: pure function compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict], no DB writes, no network, completes in under 2 seconds. Must produce at least 20 distinct scores across synthetic corpus.
